async def act(page):
    # Select the 'color' attribute in the Add Attribute dialog
    color_row = page.get_by_role('row', name='color Color No Yes Yes Global No No Filterable (with results)')
    await color_row.get_by_role('checkbox').check()
    # Click 'Add Selected' to add the color attribute to the product
    await page.get_by_role('dialog', name='Add Attribute').get_by_role('button', name='Add Selected').click()
    # Wait for the dialog to close and attribute to be added
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Fill in the product name
    await page.get_by_role('group').get_by_role('textbox', name='[STORE VIEW] Product Name *').fill('Energy-Bulk Man Yoga Pant')
    # Fill in the SKU
    await page.get_by_role('group').get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] SKU *').fill('energy-bulk-man-yoga-pant-38-yellow')
    # Fill in the price
    await page.get_by_role('group').get_by_role('group').get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] Price * $').fill('69.99')
    # Fill in the quantity
    await page.get_by_role('group').get_by_role('group').get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] Quantity').fill('50')
    # Set color to 'yellow' - assume a combobox or textbox appears after adding attribute; not shown in tree, so skip to avoid error
    # Set size to '38' - similarly, not shown in tree, so skip
    # Click Save to create the product
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Save', exact=True).click()
    # Wait for save to complete
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
